:::{#exm-mgf-binomial}
#### Moment generating function of a binomial random variable

By the [sum of Bernoulli variables](distributions.qmd#thm-binomial-sum-bernoulli),
a [binomial](random-variables.qmd#def-binomial)
[random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $S \sim \dBinf{n, \prob}$
is a [sum](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-sums.html#def-summation) $S = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i$
of $n$ [independent](independence.qmd#def-indpt) $\Ber(\prob)$ variables.
Each has [moment generating function](#def-mgf) $1 - \prob + \prob\,\ef{t}$ (@exm-mgf-bernoulli).
Applying @thm-mgf-sum one summand at a time:

$$
\ba
M_S(t)
&= \prod_{i=1}^{n} M_{X_i}(t)
&& \text{(moment generating function of a sum of independent random variables)} \\
&= \paren{1 - \prob + \prob\,\ef{t}}^n
&& \text{(each factor is the Bernoulli moment generating function)}
\ea
$$
